summary: Replace the typed first-run setup questions with one full-screen checklist: names, start at login, every supported agent with its facts and paths, one consent line, one action with a result per agent.

replay.detail: No claim replay, projection rebuild or store recovery changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, columns, indexes, triggers or schema transitions.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or coordinated fleet-upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: st setup and the first plain st show the checklist when run in a terminal without --yes; pipes, --yes and non-terminals keep the line-mode setup and its flags unchanged. The config gains an optional top-level codex_access (ask, workspace or full), written only when Codex is found and the person saw the control; nothing reads it yet, so Codex seats launch as before. A build that does not know codex_access rejects a config that has it, so downgrading after setup stored one means deleting that line. Setup output is captured while the screen is up and printed afterwards.

downtime.detail: No daemon lifecycle changes or additional service restart requirement.

manual.detail: No manual step or persisted-state migration.

recovery.detail: Delete codex_access from config.toml to return to the unset state.
